components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The gate action or the page's one forward action.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">Approve final cut <svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="m4 12.5 5 5L20 6.5"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:38px; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid #3B1C4A; border-radius:2px; background:#3B1C4A; color:#F7F1E8; font:500 12.5px/1 Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#2A1236; border-color:#2A1236; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #C9A24B; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A second action that must not compete with the gate.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; height:38px; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid #DED2BF; border-radius:2px; background:transparent; color:#1E1A22; font:500 12.5px/1 Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background 150ms, border-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:#FFFCF6; border-color:#8D8092; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #C9A24B; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Status Stamp
components.description: An exception or a gate state, always with a word.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; padding:3px 7px; border:1px solid #9E423A; border-radius:2px; background:rgba(181,84,75,0.06); color:#9E423A; font:500 8.5px/1.2 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing:0.1em; text-transform:uppercase; white-space:nowrap; }

components.name: Week Day
components.description: One day in the run of show; selected has a gold top rule, late has a rose tag.
components.css: .ds-week-day { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:5px; min-height:104px; width:100%; padding:14px; border:0; border-left:1px solid #DED2BF; border-radius:0; background:#F0E6D6; text-align:left; font-family:Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; box-shadow:inset 0 2px 0 #C9A24B; cursor:pointer; } .ds-week-day:hover { background:#FFFCF6; } .ds-wd-top { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font:400 9px/1.2 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing:0.12em; color:#6F6276; } .ds-wd-num { margin-left:auto; font-size:11px; color:#1E1A22; } .ds-wd-late { padding:1px 4px; border:1px solid rgba(181,84,75,0.45); border-radius:1px; color:#B5544B; font-size:7.5px; } .ds-wd-name { font-family:'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif; font-size:16.5px; line-height:1.12; color:#3B1C4A; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; } .ds-wd-meta { font:400 9px/1.2 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing:0.06em; color:#6F6276; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-wd-state { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; margin-top:auto; font-size:10px; color:#4B4252; } .ds-wd-time { margin-left:auto; font:400 9px/1 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; color:#6F6276; }

components.name: Scene Row
components.description: The proof margin: scene number, timecode, storyboard, on-screen line, spoken line, state and length.
components.html: 0100:00YORKTOWN HEIGHTS / 1968Yorktown Heights, 1968. Lynn Conway tells IBM she is transitioning; the company fires her.✓ Locked5.0s
components.css: .ds-scene { display:grid; grid-template-columns:52px 54px minmax(0,1fr) 86px 42px; gap:11px; align-items:center; padding:10px 0; border-bottom:1px solid #EBE1D1; background:#F7F1E8; font-family:Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-scene-margin { position:relative; align-self:stretch; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; gap:2px; padding-left:14px; } .ds-scene-margin::before { content:''; position:absolute; left:3px; top:0; bottom:0; width:1px; background:#DED2BF; } .ds-scene-margin::after { content:''; position:absolute; left:0; top:50%; width:7px; height:7px; border-radius:50%; background:#F7F1E8; border:1px solid #8D8092; transform:translateY(-50%); } .ds-scene-margin b { font:500 10px/1 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; color:#3B1C4A; } .ds-scene-margin span { font:400 8.5px/1 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; color:#6F6276; } .ds-scene-thumb { width:54px; aspect-ratio:9/16; background:#3B1C4A; } .ds-scene-main { min-width:0; } .ds-scene-on { display:block; font:400 8.5px/1.3 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing:0.08em; color:#C9A24B; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; } .ds-scene-vo { display:block; margin-top:3px; font-size:12px; line-height:1.4; color:#4B4252; overflow:hidden; display:-webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp:2; -webkit-box-orient:vertical; } .ds-scene-state { font:400 9.5px/1 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; color:#6F6276; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-scene-dur { font:400 9.5px/1 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; color:#6F6276; text-align:right; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A scene line or a note; a textarea owns its line breaks.
components.css: .ds-field { display:block; font-family:Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field > span { display:block; margin-bottom:5px; font:400 8px/1 'DM Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; letter-spacing:0.1em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#6F6276; } .ds-input { width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; padding:9px 10px; border:1px solid #DED2BF; border-radius:2px; background:#FFFCF6; color:#1E1A22; font:400 12px/1.45 Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; resize:vertical; min-height:62px; } .ds-input:focus { outline:2px solid #F3E6C8; outline-offset:0; border-color:#C9A24B; }

components.name: Archive Collage
components.description: A duotone archive print on ivory paper, taped at a slight angle, with a mono caption and a stitched gold thread.
components.css: .ds-collage { position:relative; width:320px; height:240px; background:#3B1C4A; overflow:hidden; font-family:'DM Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; } .ds-print { position:absolute; left:32px; top:24px; width:190px; padding:6px 6px 4px; margin:0; transform:rotate(-2.4deg); background:linear-gradient(180deg,#FFFCF6,#F0E6D6); border:1px solid #DED2BF; box-shadow:0 12px 26px -16px rgba(10,4,16,.9); } .ds-print::before { content:''; position:absolute; top:-8px; left:50%; width:44px; height:12px; transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(-2deg); background:rgba(226,199,140,.52); } .ds-print img { display:block; width:100%; height:142px; object-fit:cover; } .ds-print figcaption { padding-top:5px; font-size:6px; color:#3B1C4A; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; } .ds-thread { position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; }

narrative.overview: A one-person daily paper, not a monitoring wall. A proof sheet is on the desk, the week's run is pinned above it, and only the marks that need a human hand are red. Ivory paper and plum ink, gold as a proofreader's mark, terracotta as a correction. The signature is the proof margin in the scene ledger and the single approval stamp. The archive layer pins real photographs to the proof: duotone prints, tape, captions and one stitched gold thread.
keyCharacteristics: Ivory paper, plum ink, gold signal, terracotta correction, sage passed
Playfair for the story, Inter for controls, DM Mono for evidence
One cover, one decision, one gate per Reel
The week as a run of show; the cut as seven scenes
Hairlines and quiet instead of card grids
Flat at rest; depth only for objects, dialogs and drawers
Credited archive photographs on paper prints, with a stitched thread

rules.name: The One Gate Rule
rules.body: The owner approves the final cut. Script, sources, SEO, render and voice must pass automatically or stop before the gate.

rules.name: The Proof Margin Rule
rules.body: Every scene row carries its number and timecode on a 1px line with a 7px dot. The margin is the signature and the wayfinding.

rules.name: The Gold Is a Signal Rule
rules.body: Gold marks attention, selection or a human hand. It never decorates a large surface.

rules.name: The No Raw Prompt Rule
rules.body: A rule is the interface; the SOP is the receipt behind a disclosure. The owner never edits a raw prompt to change behaviour.

rules.name: The Consequence Rule
rules.body: Every action states its slot, destinations, files and undo window before the click.

dos: Do give the selected story the only 46px Playfair name.
Do keep the one gate as the single primary action.
Do use DM Mono for timecodes, counts, durations and meters.
Do show the proof margin on every scene row.
Do let the page end in quiet paper.
Do use credited archive photographs, duotoned, with the credit in Facts.
donts: Don't turn the Desk into a card grid of equal stories.
Don't use a Kanban as the home; the calendar is the plan.
Don't put Playfair on buttons, tabs or table cells.
Don't use gold as a background wash or gradient.
Don't show a raw markdown file as the agent's primary interface.
Don't regenerate the whole video from one note.
Don't use an uncredited image or an AI-generated likeness.
